name: Kinde
tagline: Auth and user management API with OAuth/OIDC and free tier
description: Kinde provides authentication, authorization, and user-management APIs for modern applications. Developers use OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect for end-user login flows and machine-to-machine tokens or Management API credentials to manage users, organizations, roles, permissions, and feature flags programmatically via REST endpoints.

auth.details: Management API uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials (M2M application) for access tokens; end-user flows use OAuth/OIDC. Bearer token in Authorization header.

use_cases: list users in a Kinde business
create or update a user via Management API
assign roles and permissions to users
